adjudication_summary: Worker-6 reopened the paper-local XML/PDF, OA package member list, figure captions, linked DBAASP/CAMP rows, and prior worker outputs. The original empty activity layer and unresolved database-audit scaffold were repaired. The paper is source-reviewed and publication-grade with cautions: source-supported activity/toxicity values are retained, compressed CAMP/database rows remain source_conflict, and figure-only values were not fabricated.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The source reports weak MIC activity for both ocellatin fragments against E. coli, activity of only Ocellatin-K1(1-16) against S. aureus, and no S. aureus activity for Ocellatin-K1(1-21) up to 1000 ug/mL.
CAMP compressed-name rows and the DBAASP/CAMP exact 125 ug/mL hemolysis call for Ocellatin-K1(1-21) are preserved as source_conflict rather than converted to clean source_verified records.

The local supplementary_original landing-*.bin files are article HTML pages and no structured supplemental assay table was recovered; XML/PDF/OA package/database sources were sufficient for the owner-layer repair.
Mechanism claims are bounded to oxidative-stress, NF-kB/ROS reporter, and erythrocyte toxicity contexts; no direct bacterial molecular target is asserted.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA-package/database evidence was sufficient for worker-2/4/6 owner-layer closeout. The supplementary_original landing files are HTML article pages and did not contain additional structured assay payloads.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay and literature rows that match primary text/Table 1 were promoted to source_verified; compressed CAMP rows and the image-only low-concentration hemolysis exact value remain source_conflict with context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Eight source-located activity/toxicity rows were recovered from XML/PDF prose, figure captions, methods, and database traceability without fabricating image-only values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to antioxidant-status, NF-kB/ROS reporter, and erythrocyte membrane/toxicity evidence; no direct antibacterial molecular target is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review: The original blocking rework ticket is closed because full source review was performed and strict rework targets are now empty.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair recovered local MIC, hemolysis, erythrocyte roughness, database identity, and bounded mechanism evidence for the two ocellatin fragments. The final state is accepted_with_cautions, not clean acceptance.
